data.strFullDescription:
Tiny House Simulator Demo 提供了一個實際操作的體驗，讓你能夠建造與創造迷你家。透過打造完美的迷你房屋來滿足特定需求，完成客戶的任務，並在拍賣任務中測試你的技能，策略性的建築會有回報。

[img]https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3233620/extras/title-features-zh-TW.png?t=1732892572[/img]

[imgvid poster.avif="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3233620/extras/392bda1b75baba9dfd3a7c1cbff06e2f.poster.avif?t=1732892572" webm="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3233620/extras/392bda1b75baba9dfd3a7c1cbff06e2f.webm?t=1732892572" webp="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3233620/extras/392bda1b75baba9dfd3a7c1cbff06e2f.webp?t=1732892572" width="616" height="250"][/imgvid]
為客戶打造迷你房屋：設計獨特且迷人的拖車迷你家。根據每位客戶的喜好來個性化每一個家，加入你自己的風格。不論是創造迷人的小木屋還是優雅的極簡主義房屋，可能性無窮無盡！

[img]https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3233620/extras/title-explore-zh-TW.png?t=1732892572[/img]

[imgvid poster.avif="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3233620/extras/1dd2f6f5e9d2d49d9e0dd1253de79749.poster.avif?t=1732892572" webm="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3233620/extras/1dd2f6f5e9d2d49d9e0dd1253de79749.webm?t=1732892572" webp="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3233620/extras/1dd2f6f5e9d2d49d9e0dd1253de79749.webp?t=1732892572" width="616" height="250"][/imgvid]
展開一段冒險，探索一個多彩且多樣化的島嶼，每個轉角都揭開新的驚喜。發現西海岸的熱鬧城鎮，在寧靜的中央湖旁放鬆，或向東南的山區探險。

[img]https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3233620/extras/title-freedom-zh-TW.png?t=1732892572[/img]

[img]https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3233620/extras/freedom.gif?t=1732892572[/img]
掌控你的業務發展，設計你的迷你房屋，並探索 Tiny Island。開放世界的遊戲玩法提供了根據個人風格量身定制的無限體驗。

[img]https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3233620/extras/title-tow-zh-TW.png?t=1732892572[/img]

[imgvid poster.avif="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3233620/extras/cfe902188e749e87a1c3f14eb524e8e9.poster.avif?t=1732892572" webm="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3233620/extras/cfe902188e749e87a1c3f14eb524e8e9.webm?t=1732892572" webp="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3233620/extras/cfe902188e749e87a1c3f14eb524e8e9.webp?t=1732892572" width="616" height="250"][/imgvid]
將你的創作連接到可靠的車輛，並將它們送到島上的滿意客戶手中。沿著蜿蜒的道路、風景如畫的小徑和挑戰性的地形駕駛，以便按時交付。

[img]https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3233620/extras/title-business-zh-TW.png?t=1732892572[/img]

[imgvid poster.avif="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3233620/extras/9e54439ec1b2a7731a6db528e5f08a56.poster.avif?t=1732892572" webm="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3233620/extras/9e54439ec1b2a7731a6db528e5f08a56.webm?t=1732892572" webp="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3233620/extras/9e54439ec1b2a7731a6db528e5f08a56.webp?t=1732892572" width="616" height="250"][/imgvid]
管理並擴展你的迷你房屋業務。投資你辛辛苦賺來的錢，升級你的工作坊，獲得更好的車輛，或在當地賭場碰碰運氣。目標是建造更大更有趣的房屋！

[img]https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3233620/extras/title-scenery-zh-TW.png?t=1732892572[/img]

[imgvid poster.avif="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3233620/extras/5947fa6356bf2f5f3d13aafcd251776c.poster.avif?t=1732892572" webm="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3233620/extras/5947fa6356bf2f5f3d13aafcd251776c.webm?t=1732892572" webp="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3233620/extras/5947fa6356bf2f5f3d13aafcd251776c.webp?t=1732892572" width="616" height="250"][/imgvid]
享受壯麗的景色和景點，包括一個遊樂園、山丘上的風車，和一座位於小島上的燈塔。在沙灘上放鬆，或探索西南方熱鬧的機場。

你準備好迎接最終的迷你房屋挑戰了嗎？開始這段刺激的冒險，將你的小規模夢想變成一個蓬勃發展的業務！
今天就到 Steam 上獲得 Tiny House Simulator，開始創造你夢想中的家！
data.strSnippet: Tiny House Simulator: Demo 邀請你在前兩個任務中設計和建造舒適且富有創意的迷你家。為客戶建造定制的房屋，參加刺激的拍賣，並探索開放世界。快來體驗完整遊戲的創意和魅力！
